description: Mechanical transcriptions of the conformance spec's worked examples. The spec's own sentence is the assertion: 'an implementation conforms when it reproduces each example's output byte-for-byte.' Only the examples the spec gives as COMPLETE documents are transcribed here (FIX-01, FIX-02/C1, FIX-08/C7, FIX-09/C8, FIX-13/M1). The snippet-form examples (C2-C6, C9, the 8.1 head, the 9 one-liner) need invented document wrappers and are transcribed during Phase 2 of docs/migration-plan.md, next to the merge engine they test — inventing their wrappers before an implementer can run them risks silently diverging from spec intent. FIX-06 and FIX-10 are already realized as landmines misaddressed-fill and slot-in-template.

harnessContract.run: per case: unify build -s <case>/src -o <tmp>/dist; exit 0; zero diagnostics; byte-exact bidirectional tree compare against expected/
harnessContract.assetStubs: cases whose spec example references /assets/style.css or /assets/team.jpg include stub files so the post-build reference check passes. The stubs are NOT part of the spec's byte-exact claim; the composed pages are, byte for byte.
